title: 2013 Prairie's rear block gets its open rooftop porch
items: The rear block behind 2013 Prairie now rises two tall storeys to an open, roofed porch on its top floor, as the house's 2003 National Register photographs show it and its nomination describes: "the top floor of the rear section is open to provide a terrace".
The porch stands on slender iron posts behind an iron railing, under a flat roof just below the wall beside it, and the house's view from the north is now signed off against its photograph.
